_metadata.description: Emergency resources for the Student Wellbeing Triage System.
_metadata.admin_note: IMPORTANT: All phone numbers and contact details must be verified by a university administrator before deployment. Placeholder entries are clearly marked with VERIFY_BEFORE_DEPLOYMENT.

global.disclaimer: This system is not a replacement for professional mental health care. If you are in immediate danger, please call your local emergency services immediately.
global.crisis_message: You are not alone. Immediate help is available. Please reach out to one of the contacts below — they are trained to support you right now.

emergency_contacts.name: Emergency Services
emergency_contacts.description: Call immediately if you or someone else is in immediate danger.

emergency_contacts.name: Samaritans
emergency_contacts.description: Free confidential listening support, available any time of day or night.

emergency_contacts.name: University Counselling Service
emergency_contacts.description: Your university's professional counselling team. Human support is available.
emergency_contacts.admin_note: Replace with your institution's actual counselling service contact details.

emergency_contacts.name: University Security / Campus Emergency
emergency_contacts.description: Campus security for immediate on-site support.
emergency_contacts.admin_note: Replace with your campus security number.
